funding.name: Tennessee Promise
funding.provides: Last-dollar scholarship and mentoring program covering tuition and mandatory fees not covered by gift aid at Tennessee community colleges, TCATs and other eligible institutions.
funding.eligibility: Complete the Promise application by November 2, complete the FAFSA by April 1, attend a mandatory meeting, and complete 16 hours of community service each year (per page).
funding.amount: Last-dollar: tuition and mandatory fees not covered by Pell, HOPE or TSAA (per page)
funding.how_to_apply: Apply through the THEC Student Portal; application opens April 1 each year (per page).

funding.name: Tennessee HOPE Scholarship
funding.provides: Lottery-funded scholarship for entering freshmen enrolled at an eligible postsecondary institution.
funding.eligibility: Entering freshmen enrolled at an eligible institution within sixteen months after graduating from a Tennessee eligible high school (per page).
funding.amount: Up to $8,550 for full-time enrollment (per page)
funding.how_to_apply: Two ways to apply, depending on program: THEC Student Portal or FAFSA (per page).
